title: Iridescent Button
summary: A button whose gradient shifts on hover.
description: A button whose gradient shifts on hover.
accessibility_notes: Iridescent surfaces have unpredictable local contrast — never place body text directly on one.
ai_usage: Playful primary actions. Transition background-position rather than the colours themselves — browsers cannot interpolate multi-stop gradients smoothly.
source:
<!DOCTYPE html>
<html lang="en">
<head>
  <meta charset="UTF-8" />
  <meta name="viewport" content="width=device-width, initial-scale=1" />
  <title>Iridescent Button</title>
  <script type="application/json" id="effect-meta">
  {
    "id": "iridescent-button",
    "title": "Iridescent Button",
    "summary": "A button whose gradient shifts on hover.",
    "description": "A button whose gradient shifts on hover.",
    "theme": "holographic-metallic",
    "categories": ["material", "holographic"],
    "tags": ["holographic", "metallic", "button", "iridescent", "hover", "gradient"],
    "tech": ["css"],
    "era": "2020s",
    "difficulty": "intermediate",
    "dependencies": [],
    "browser_support": "All modern browsers (Chromium, Firefox, Safari).",
    "performance_notes": "Lightweight — composited transform/opacity work only.",
    "accessibility_notes": "Iridescent surfaces have unpredictable local contrast — never place body text directly on one.",
    "customization": [
      { "name": "--dur", "description": "Shift duration", "default": "0.6s" }
    ],
    "variations": ["Retune the palette", "Scale for a compact variant"],
    "ai_usage": "Playful primary actions. Transition background-position rather than the colours themselves — browsers cannot interpolate multi-stop gradients smoothly."
  }
  </script>
  <style>
    *, *::before, *::after { box-sizing: border-box; }
    html, body { height: 100%; margin: 0; }
    body { display: grid; place-items: center; background: #0b0d12; color: #e7ebf3;
      font-family: system-ui, -apple-system, "Segoe UI", Roboto, sans-serif; overflow: hidden; }
    .fx { padding: .95rem 2.2rem; border: 0; border-radius: 999px; font-weight: 800; color: #10061c; cursor: pointer;
      background: linear-gradient(100deg, #a855f7, #22d3ee, #fbbf24, #ff2d95, #a855f7); background-size: 300% 100%;
      transition: background-position .6s ease; box-shadow: 0 10px 26px rgba(168,85,247,.4); }
    .fx:hover { background-position: 100% 0; }
  </style>
</head>
<body>
  <button class="fx" type="button">Shimmer</button>
</body>
</html>
